headline: Moved into non-public session under RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c); no votes opposed.
summary: Councilors voted without dissent to move into non-public session and later voted to leave it. Councilors Schlosser, Schultz and Todd were excused.
plain_text:
Ad-Hoc City Manager Search Committee 
Draft Meeting Minutes 
November 12, 2026  
City Council Chambers 
37 Green Street  
6:00 PM 
1. Mayor Champlin called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.  
 
2. Roll Call.  
 
Present:  Councilor Brown, Mayor Champlin, Councilors Davie, Fennessy, Foote, Grady-
Sexton, Horne, Kalob, Keach, Kretovic, Kurtz and Councilor Sekou 
 
Excused:  Councilors Schlosser, Schultz and Todd 
 
3. Mayor Champlin provided an overview of the meeting.  
 
4. Non-public session in accordance with RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c)  
 
Action: At 6:01 p.m., Councilor Kretovic moved to enter non-public session in accordance 
with RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c).  The motion was duly seconded by Councilor Kurtz and 
passed with no dissenting votes.   
 
5. Adjournment. 
 
Action: At 9:38 p.m., Councilor Kurtz moved to exit non-public session.  The motion was 
duly seconded by Councilor Kretovic and passed with no dissenting votes.   
 
 
A true copy: I attest: 
 
Janice Bonenfant 
City Clerk
